svg.title: November Painting
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and standardized vivid screen colour approximate. Black fragment positions and contours traced from the actually inspected colour reproduction in the MACBA publication, printed page197, and compared with the1973 MoMA plate. Cream ground standardized as off-white; subtle white-on-cream paper fragment boundaries, brush texture and aging are simplified. This is an interpretive diagram of the observed arrangement, not a photographic facsimile.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://img.macba.cat/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Bois_eng.pdf#page=10; catalogue record moma1973-pdf42-caption1; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
